newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to seek views on foreign bank ownership.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to seek views on foreign bank ownership.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Virawan said on Tuesday a review of foreign ownership restrictions on Thai bank and finance firms would include a local industry consensus.
"We are exploring the idea with them and assessing whether they would like to do that or not. The idea is to do that with their consent and to see if they want it," Amnuay told Reuters.

He said the review of limits which currently prohibit foreigners from taking more than a 25 percent holding in Thai finance houses and in commercial banks was part of a wider drive to encourage foreign investment in Thailand.
"We don't just want to encourage foreign investment in banks or finance companies but we want to encourage foreign investment generally," Amnuay said.
Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond said Monday the bank was considering proposals to relax foreign ownership restrictions.
Analysts had said that if the proposal to increase foreign ownership limits became reality it could cause the premiums fetched by bank counters on the foreign board over the main board to fall.
